A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Creative by nature. Curious by choice. A problem-solver at heart.

I've always enjoyed creating things, figuring things out, and finding ways to make them better. That curiosity eventually led me into digital marketing, where I get to work with both creativity and technology.

Over the years, I've worked on websites, marketing funnels, CRM systems, and automations. I've had the chance to take ideas from planning to execution, work through technical challenges, and make sure the little details don't get overlooked.

I'm naturally hands-on. I like exploring new tools, testing ideas, solving problems, and figuring out how things work. If there's a better way to do something, I'll probably want to find it. I enjoy learning as I go, taking on new challenges, and turning what I've learned into something useful.

I'm also someone who believes there's always room to improve. Whether it's a new skill, a different approach, or a tool I've never used before, I'm always open to learning and seeing what I can create with it.

WHAT KEEPS ME GOING

Creating something meaningful, figuring out what seems impossible at first, and seeing an idea come to life.

A little name with a big heart behind it. ♡

I created Zee Success because I believe every business owner deserves a chance to see their ideas come to life and their business grow.

I love creating things, figuring out how stuff works, and finding ways to make things better. And honestly, I wanted to use those skills for something meaningful.

Whether it’s building a website, creating a funnel, connecting tools, or figuring out a smarter way to get things done, I want my work to make a real difference.

The name Zee Success comes from that simple intention: I want to help business owners succeed in whatever way I can. I want to understand what they need, find solutions that actually work, and create experiences that make their lives a little easier and their goals a little closer.

Because it’s not just about making things look good. It’s about making things work, making people feel supported, and helping turn their ideas into something they’re proud of.

And if I can be part of that journey? That’s a win for me. ♡

Multi-Client Project Experience

Behind the scenes of multiple digital projects.

At Doneverse, I worked as a Marketing Funnel Specialist, supporting multiple client projects across different industries. I was involved in building funnels, websites, and landing pages, as well as making sure each deliverable was ready for launch.

My work went beyond development. I reviewed funnel strategies and copy, checked designs and functionality, conducted funnel audits, and worked on improvements to ensure each project met quality standards.

Although I can't publicly share those client projects due to confidentiality, the work gave me valuable experience in managing different project requirements, solving problems, and delivering quality digital experiences.

Funnel Development · Strategy & Copy Review · Design QA · Funnel Auditing · Quality Assurance
